privacy.seoDescription: Privacy policy for Quiz Couple - Personal data protection and GDPR compliance.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy defines and informs you of how Quiz Couple uses and protects the information you provide to us, in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
privacy.s2_1Intro: To improve your experience, we use your browser's local storage (LocalStorage) for:
privacy.s2_1Item2: Remembering your theme preferences (light or dark mode)
privacy.s2_1Item3: Keeping results from your previous quizzes
privacy.s2_1ImportantText: This data is stored exclusively on your device and is never transmitted to our servers or to third parties. You can delete it at any time by clearing your browser's browsing data.
privacy.s2_2Intro: Some features are open without an account. To stop the same person leaving ten reviews on the same test or voting several times on the same dilemma, we process one technical item:
privacy.s2_2Item1Text: used only to recognise a submission already made and block duplicates
privacy.s2_2Item2Text: to apply that limit over time
privacy.s2_2ImportantText: This data is not used for profiling, advertising or audience measurement. It is never cross-referenced with the answers you give in the quizzes. The IP address of a review is erased after six months (the review itself stays published); the one of a custom quiz disappears with the quiz, after a week.
privacy.s2_3Intro: When you request free content (e-book, guide), we collect the following information with your explicit consent:
privacy.s2_3Item2Text: To send you the requested content and, with your consent, occasional informational communications
privacy.s2_3Item3Text: To identify the content you requested
privacy.s2_3ImportantText: You can withdraw your consent at any time by contacting us at the address indicated below. Your data will then be deleted within 30 days. If you don't ask, they are deleted three years after your request, and after 30 days if the address was never confirmed.
privacy.s2_4Intro: To know which pages are read and which are not, we count visits ourselves, without going through an outside service. Each page displayed records three pieces of information, and nothing else:
privacy.s2_4Item1Text: to know which one was viewed, and in which language
privacy.s2_4Item2Text: to link together the pages of a single visit. It disappears after 30 minutes without a new page and is never reused: if you come back tomorrow you are a new visit, and nothing makes it possible to connect it to the previous one
privacy.s2_4Item3Text: its domain name only (a search engine, a social network), never the full address nor the words you typed
privacy.s2_4ImportantText: No IP address, no browser fingerprint and no personal data is recorded. These figures serve only to produce overall statistics for this site, are shared with no one and are cross-referenced with no other source. On that basis this measurement falls under the consent exemption for audience measurement and therefore does not depend on the cookie banner. The data is kept for 13 months at most.
privacy.s3Intro: Quiz Couple uses Google Analytics 4 to measure the site's audience, and the ad network The Moneytizer to display advertising. The network works with advertising partners listed in our ads.txt file. These services place cookies on your browser.
privacy.s3Item1: Consent is collected by a platform certified under IAB TCF v2.2, which passes your choice, purpose by purpose, to each of the partners. No analytics or advertising cookie is placed before you answer
privacy.s3Item2: If you decline, no browsing data is collected and the ads shown are not personalised. Our own audience measurement, described in section 2.4, keeps working: it uses neither cookies nor personal data
privacy.s3Item3: Analytics data is anonymised and cannot be used to identify you personally
privacy.s3Item4: If you accept, the advertising partners may use your browsing to personalise the ads. You can adjust this at any time from your Google ad settings
privacy.s3Outro: You can change your mind at any time using the “Manage cookies” link at the bottom of every page. For more on how Google handles cookies, see Google's privacy policy.
privacy.s4Intro: We implement the following security measures to protect your browsing:
privacy.s4Item1Text: All communications between your browser and our site are encrypted
privacy.s4Item2Text: Technical data is stored securely with strict access policies
privacy.s4Item3Text: We only collect data strictly necessary for the service to function
privacy.s4Item4Text: We follow best practices in secure web development
privacy.s5Intro: In accordance with the GDPR, you have the following rights:
privacy.s5Item1Text: Obtain confirmation of whether your data is being processed
privacy.s5Item4Text: Receive your data in a structured format
privacy.s5Item5Text: Object to the processing of your data
privacy.s5Outro: To exercise these rights, write to us at the address below: we reply within a month.
privacy.s6Text: The site itself is hosted by GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc., 88 Colin P. Kelly Jr. Street, San Francisco, CA 94107, United States). The data you send us is stored in a database managed by Supabase, acting as a processor under the GDPR. This covers the first name and comment you leave in a review, messages sent through the contact form, the email address and first name provided when requesting free content, and the anti-duplicate technical data described in 2.2. Quiz plays are counted in a form that cannot identify you: only the test name and the language are recorded, never your answers. None of these processors is allowed to use this data for its own purposes. Messages sent through the contact form are erased one year after they are sent. A published review stays online as long as the page exists; you can ask for it to be removed at any time.
privacy.s7Text: Our site may contain links to external sites. We invite you to consult the privacy policies of these sites, as we are not responsible for their data protection practices.
privacy.s8Text: We reserve the right to modify this privacy policy at any time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an update date. We encourage you to check this page regularly.
privacy.s9Text: For any question or request for information about the site, please use our
privacy.bilanIntro: The relationship assessment is the only service on the site that saves answers to questions. Here's exactly what is kept, and for how long.
bilanItems: What is saved: both partners' first names and, if they give it, their gender, the couple's situation (living together, children, etc.) and each person's answers, including on sensitive topics within the meaning of article 9 of the GDPR (sex life, religious beliefs, political opinions). One email address per person, to receive the report and find the assessment again. No account.
The legal basis: the explicit consent each partner gives for their own answers, by ticking a box before the first question. It can be withdrawn at any time by deleting the assessment.

Who sees them: the two of you, and nobody else. Your partner sees your answers in the report once you've both finished. The keys to your personal links are only kept as a fingerprint that can't be reversed.

On your own: if you take the assessment alone, what you think your partner would answer is saved with your answers, under your link only. Your partner isn't contacted or informed, and nothing is shown to them.

How long: an unpaid assessment is erased 60 days after the last answer, a paid one six months after payment, together with the PDF report and the email addresses. Either of you can delete it straight away from the report. Only anonymous counters (page visits, assessments created, finished and paid per day) are kept beyond that.

Payment: it goes through Stripe (Stripe Payments Europe, Ltd., Dublin, Ireland), which processes payment data under its own privacy policy. We never see your card: we keep the payment session number, its amount and the receipt email address, to send you the report and be able to answer a refund request.

Sending the report: the PDF report is kept in private storage with our host (Supabase). The addresses given receive a personal link to the report through our email provider, Resend (Resend, Inc., United States, European Commission standard contractual clauses): the report itself does not go through Resend and does not stay in inboxes. The link that downloads the PDF is only valid for a few minutes, and the page gives a new one for as long as the assessment exists.

Emails about the assessment: when the second person has finished answering, the first gets an email saying the report is ready. If the report still hasn't been unlocked the next day, each of you gets a single reminder, and then nothing more. Each of these emails has a link to stop them, and they stop as soon as the report is paid for. They contain nothing of your answers.
A fingerprint of the IP address: salted and impossible to reverse, kept with the assessment to limit the number of assessments created per hour from the same connection.
privacy.emailsIntro: At the end of some tests, we offer to let you leave your email address to see the rest of your results. The e-book form does the same. Here's what happens with it.
emailsItems: What is saved: your email address, your first name if you give it (we ask for it, without obligation, once your results are unlocked, so our emails can start with your name), the language of the site you were using, the page the address comes from (which test, or the e-book), the date of your consent, and a fingerprint of your IP address (salted, impossible to reverse) to limit abuse. No surname, no test result. These emails are for people aged 15 or over.
Why: to send you, in your language, tips for your relationship and news from Quiz Couple: new tests, and the relationship assessment with its offers. Your address is never sold or shared with anyone.
The legal basis: your consent, given by ticking the box. You can withdraw it at any time: every email contains a one-click unsubscribe link, and we stop writing to you.

How long: as long as you're subscribed, then the address is deleted three years after your last contact with us (the last time you left your address or opened one of our emails). An unsubscribed or dead address is deleted within three months.

Who sends it: our emails go out through Resend (Resend Inc., United States, European Commission standard contractual clauses) from a quiz-couple.com address; the list is hosted by Supabase (European Union).
privacy.s5Item6Text: Ask that your data no longer be used, without being deleted, while a request is being handled
privacy.s5Item7Text: At any time, for processing based on it (emails, relationship assessment), without affecting what was done before
privacy.s5Item8Text: With the CNIL (cnil.fr), the French data protection authority, or the authority of your country, if you believe your rights are not respected

mentions.s8P1: Quiz Couple takes part in affiliate programmes. In practice, some links on the site point to partners, and a purchase made after following one of those links may earn us a commission. The price you pay is exactly the same either way.
mentions.s8P2: We would rather say so plainly than let you work it out. Every page that carries this kind of link shows a visible notice, right where the link appears, so you always know what you are dealing with before you click.
mentions.s8P3: These partnerships never decide what we write. We only keep partners whose offer relates directly to couple life, whose quality we would consider good enough to recommend to someone close to us, and who stay in line with the site's editorial stance. A partner that no longer meets those conditions is dropped, commission or not.
